dedupe_keys.name: italian ministry of health open data register of all pharmacies open to the public with address type and coordinates daily

description: This register lists every pharmacy in Italy that is open to the public, including branch pharmacies and seasonal dispensaries, which are often the nearest point of health care for small communities. It is published by the Italian Ministry of Health as part of its medicine traceability system and refreshed every day. Each row gives the ministry code and local health authority code, name, VAT number, full address down to hamlet, municipality, province and region codes, the type of outlet, latitude and longitude where known, and the start and end dates of validity, so closed or changed pharmacies remain in the file. The register is available as a free daily download in CSV, XML and JSON under the Italian Open Data Licence, with a data dictionary. Caveats: some coordinates are missing or taken from OpenStreetMap, historical rows must be filtered by validity dates to get the current network, and opening hours and staffing are not included. Simulation uses: mapping access to medicines and first-line health services, testing exposure of pharmacies to floods, earthquakes or power cuts, and planning emergency medicine distribution. Related records: the Italian medicine distribution sites (data-italy-medicine-distribution-sites) cover the wholesale layer that supplies these pharmacies, and the Italian hospital bed data (data-italy-hospital-beds-by-structure-2010-2017) cover hospitals.
